tagline: Crafting resilient, high-performance web applications and intuitive digital experiences with secure engineering practices.
shortBio: I am a Computer Science undergraduate passionate about building secure web applications, sleek user interfaces, and scalable systems. Driven by curiosity in modern software development and cybersecurity, I combine aesthetic craft with robust code.
fullBio: I am a Computer Science undergraduate at Eastern University of Sri Lanka with a strong passion for Full-Stack Development and Cybersecurity. As the founder of the digital brand mr.nexora, I blend creative digital media with solid engineering principles. My work revolves around modern web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Python, C++, MySQL), secure coding patterns, and intuitive UI/UX design. I believe in writing readable, maintainable code, solving real-world challenges, and continuously pushing the envelope of technology.
